The amber garden trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.
The ivory harbor trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do the invented learning-garden trials report about recall after guided sessions?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the public synthetic fixture (fixture-001.json)
- Reports a learning-garden trial outcome on recall
- Any year, English

## Exclusion criteria
- Records not present in the supplied fixture
- No reported recall outcome

## Query log
| Date | Backend | Query | Hits |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-07 | supplied fixture (invented-index) | none; corpus supplied directly as synthetic input | 2 |

No live backend searches were run. Every record is invented, so OpenAlex, arXiv, and Europe PMC cannot return them.

## Screening
2 records screened, 2 included, 0 excluded.

## Notes for evaluation
- Claims, source texts, synthesis wording, and the reference list are copied verbatim from the fixture.
- Reference [1] as supplied ("Signal Gardens for Memory and Signal Gardens for Reasoning") contains both corpus titles as complete token sequences and carries no DOI. It was preserved unaltered, not corrected.
- Bibliography verification (verify_citations.py) was not run because the DOIs are invented. Validation, repair, and delivery are owned by the evaluation harness.
The amber garden trial found stable recall [1]. The ivory harbor trial found stable recall [2].
